preflight.occurrence_check_limit: The alias is <location_code>~<rank of the raw id among that day's occurrences at that location> (plan-experiments anonymizeResponse). The check detects added or removed students, a change of location, direction or anchor, a rank shift, and a change of the Sw/So count of a wave. It cannot detect a different student at the same location and rank; rule (d) (base routes equal to the 4sw5so routes) is the backstop.
